children: Overview
China property management firm's interim revenue fell 7.4% yr/yr for six months ended June 2026
Net loss attributable to equity holders was RMB106.2 mln, compared to a profit last year
Gross profit dropped 36.2% yr/yr, reflecting lower margins
Outlook
Liaoning Qisheng partners extend the sewage-treatment project capital-contribution deadline to 31 Dec. 2026
Shimao Services extends the expected timeline to use remaining listing and top-up placing proceeds to 2026
Result Drivers
PROPERTY MANAGEMENT REVENUE DROP - Revenue from property management services fell 9.0% yr/yr, weighing on overall results
LOWER GROSS MARGINS - Gross profit declined 36.2% yr/yr, reflecting lower margins
